# pacman

Arch Linux package maintenance: orphan cleanup and cache pruning.

---

## `pacman_clean_cache`

Prune old package versions from the pacman cache. Keeps the currently installed versions.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Deletes cached packages, so downgrading later means re-downloading.

**Usage**

```sh
pacman_clean_cache
```

**Examples**

```sh
pacman_clean_cache
```

**Requires** `pacman`

**OS** Linux only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/linux/pacman.sh:54`](../../modules/linux/pacman.sh#L54)

**See also** `https://wiki.archlinux.org/index.php/pacman#Cleaning_the_package_cache`

---

## `pacman_list_orphans`

List packages that were pulled in as dependencies and are no longer required by anything.

**Usage**

```sh
pacman_list_orphans
```

**Examples**

```sh
pacman_list_orphans
```

**Requires** `pacman`

**OS** Linux only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/linux/pacman.sh:17`](../../modules/linux/pacman.sh#L17)

---

## `pacman_remove_orphans`

Remove every orphaned package, along with its dependencies and configuration files.

> **⚠ DANGER** — Uninstalls packages. Read the list before saying yes.

**Usage**

```sh
pacman_remove_orphans
```

**Examples**

```sh
pacman_remove_orphans
```

**Requires** `pacman`

**OS** Linux only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/linux/pacman.sh:29`](../../modules/linux/pacman.sh#L29)

**See also** `pacman_list_orphans`
